map.多次水洗为什么不是简单相加？: Why Don't Multiple Washes Simply Add Up?
map.每次去除的是当前残余的一部分，符合稀释衰减，故总残余率按 (1-r)^n 累积，: Each wash removes a fraction of what remains, which is a dilution decay, so the total residual accumulates as (1-r)^n rather than n×r.
map.怎样更节水？: How Can I Save More Water?
